name: His Man
description:
As South Korea's very first BL dating reality series, His Man brings together a group of eight hot, sexy, free and single gay men to a shared house where they are to live, interact and open up to each other in their quest for "true love."

☆ Say hello to South Korea's first-ever BL reality dating series.

☆ "Real" is the name of the game as eight of Korea's most eligible gay bachelors are put together under one roof for eight straight days as they genuinely seek to find their "one and only".

videos.title: Our ideal type?
videos.overview:
Six gay men find themselves entering a shared house to officially begin their eight-day cohabitation life together. Immediately upon checking in, they're tasked to go on a date with one another at random. Do they have it in them to leave a good impression of each other on their very first meeting?

As the night sets in, there's a "love" hotline waiting for guys to confess their feelings to the one they like. So, who is it that each of them will call?

videos.title: Is it friendship or love?
videos.overview:
A brand new day calls for a brand new date and compared to yesterday's random pairing, the guys are finally allowed to pick who they want to go out with this time around. Curious about the most popular man in the house?

Meanwhile, an unknown figure is seen approaching the premise. Could it be that there's a new member joining the rest of our six bachelors?

videos.title: New "His Man" member
videos.overview:
Say hello to the seventh man! With the arrival of the newest member, the guys are finally allowed to disclose their age and occupation to each other with the actual age of some of the members leaving everyone stunned. As the newest member to arrive at the house, the seventh man is given a special chance to go on a date with the guy of his choice.

So, just who will he pick out of our beloved six?

videos.title: Secret date
videos.overview:
Just when you thought things couldn't get any more exciting, the eight and the final member makes his grand entrance to the house. And rumor has it that he's already been on a secret date with one of our seven guys?

As the eight spend more time together, they gradually begin expressing their true feelings to each other that leads to the possibility of some really sweet romances but at the same time, some sad and bitter heartbreaks.

videos.title: Night of confession
videos.overview:
Trring, Trring! It’s time for the “love“ hotline again. With all of the eight lads in the house now, is there a chance of it affecting everyone’s original choice? Or are they as determined as ever?

While some of the guys can’t wait to call the one they like, the rest are increasingly hesitant to make up their minds. But regardless of the case, let us see if our boys have what it takes to seize the opportunity to communicate their feelings to the one they truly want and desire.

videos.title: New roommate
videos.overview:
The heat is on! It's either win or lose for our beloved eight as they are given a golden opportunity to reallocate their rooms and through a fierce game of "go-kart racing".

The rules are simple: Beat your rivals to the chase and come out on top and you'll be the first one to choose where and whom you want to stay with. So what are we waiting for? Let the games begin, Fellas.

videos.title: What brings them out of the world
videos.overview:
It's been a sleepless night for all our boys as they've had to bid goodbyes to their former space and now find themselves amidst a new change of environment with a completely new set of roommates having changed their rooms.

Upon getting up in the morning, the eight gather to sing and play board games together and eventually take the time to share their stories with each other. Ultimately, everyone is left teary-eyed as they recall all of the struggles and the bitter experiences they've had to face with being gay.

videos.title: Mingled Letters
videos.overview:
Do you have someone you want to date? Then, what are you waiting for? Just write to him already!

Unexpectedly, it looks like only two out of our eight fellas share the same thought and mind. So, what kind of sweet sparks are set to fly when they embark on their solo dating trip? Trust us, we're as curious as you are.

videos.title: Last roommate
videos.overview:
A new day's in and a new adventure begins. It's an early start for our guys as they need to pack their bags and move out of the house they've lived in for the past six days to head to the stunning city of Namyangju! As they go through the process of choosing a roommate all over again, a certain someone is faced with the daunting task of making a choice in public because he's the hottest and the most popular of them all?

As our fellas engage themselves in some seriously exciting one-on-one outdoor activities, their feelings for each other gradually becomes clearer.

videos.title: The exciting last night
videos.overview:
It's the final leg of the journey for our lovely eight as they spend their last night in the comfort and beauty of the mesmerizing Namyangju. As they guys gather together for an engaging night of barbecue and endless chats, a sense of reluctance fills the air with none of them wanting the trip to end.

Meanwhile, there's also that "burning" question that's stuck on everyone's mind…..

videos.title: My man? His man?
videos.overview:
Finally, the time has come! After seven nights and eight days of living together, the guys have to make their final choice about the person they want to be with. And all that they'll have to do is write their phone number down and drop it in the person's mailbox.

Curious about who picks who? Well tune into the grand and exciting finale of His Man, now available to stream!

videos.title: The First Blind Date
videos.overview: After the dinner where all the men move in, it's time for phone calls; one of the men seems to be particularly in demand!

videos.title: The Date That Is Taken Away
videos.overview: One of the couples that have matched have suddenly been broken up by a new member joining the house! Who will be left out in the cold?

videos.title: The First Impression
videos.overview: Eight contestants have arrived, and they finally reveal their ages and occupations. The differences between the contestants ends up being an unexpected surprise.

videos.title: Taking a Hint
videos.overview: Date time has come again; the three men who get the date card have the power to immediately invite who they want to go with!

videos.title: Secret Story
videos.overview: After dinner, everyone plays a round of Jenga, and the contestant's real feelings start to pour out.

videos.title: Reset
videos.overview: After spending a few nights together, the time has finally come to change rooms; who does everyone want to room with?

videos.title: Voice Messages
videos.overview: The format has changed from phone calls to voice memos, will this change give the guys a chance to bravely say how they feel?

videos.title: "First" Date
videos.overview: This time the rules for the dates are different, because there's a chance the contestants might get rejected!

videos.title: True Hearts
videos.overview: On this night the contestants can hear what kind of voice messages were left for them, what kind of exciting and private messages await them?

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The two people who called each other get to go on an individual date, while the rest of the contestants go on a group date. Who's the lucky couple?

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The anonymous chat rooms are about to be opened, and everyone has two chances to join them!

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: The day before making the final decision, some of the contestants want to clear some things off their chests.

videos.title: The Last Message
videos.overview: The eve of the last telephone call, all the contestants need to carefully consider their final choice.

videos.title: Someone Who Makes Your Heart Flutter
videos.overview: After listening to the last voicemails, the contestants need to make their final choice. Can you guess who the couples will be?

videos.title: The First Meeting, and Secret Phone Call
videos.overview: The romance between the men has returned, even more intense than before. With expressions mingling awkwardness and anticipation, the participants come seeking connections. During the first call time, after one person hangs up the receiver, for some reason, the phone rings again...

videos.title: Unexpected Encounters
videos.overview: The nerve-wracking first day came to an end, and the second day arrived. On this day, they went on dates in unexpected pairings. However, after everyone left the “men’s house,” a new resident appeared. This new resident met the members on their dates in an unexpected way...

videos.title: Familiar Faces
videos.overview: The participants have finally all gathered. With the arrival of two new residents, the atmosphere in the house is filled with excitement and anticipation. However, on closer inspection, there are two people who seem a bit bewildered. Could something have happened to them?

videos.title: The Second Phone Call
videos.overview: After everyone revealed their age and occupation, chaos erupted all over the "man's house." With various emotions such as irritation, anticipation, and anxiety, they enter the second call time. Who will they call?

videos.title: Fair Competiton
videos.overview: Only the six people who get their hands on the mission card first can go on a date. But will they be able to talk to the guy they're after? Meanwhile, the two who were late are left at home. The atmosphere during that time is almost like a date at home, but...

videos.title: A Secret Night Date
videos.overview: He couldn't help but ask him out on a date in front of everyone! While the six others were taken aback, the two of them eagerly left the house. The men's hearts began to stir all at once, but who will get the call during today's call time?

videos.title: The Men Who Returned, and the Men Who Are New
videos.overview: Nine men come together in search of real love. Each of them carries a story they cannot easily share. The more they want to know about one another, the more they feel the need to hide. So what is really going on inside their hearts?

videos.title: Love Begins Again for the Men
videos.overview: The arrival of a new man shakes up the house. On the first night, feelings are revealed through late-night phone calls. As their hearts begin to move once more, will those feelings reach one another?

videos.title: Tangled Threads of Emotion
videos.overview: The men finally begin to lean into their romantic storylines. Some hesitate because they know the other person too well, while others struggle because they know nothing at all. Getting closer to someone they like feels harder than ever. As emotions grow tangled among the men, the identity of another unfamiliar man making his way to “His Man’s House” is about to be revealed.

videos.title: A Love Destined to Be Stolen and Lost
videos.overview: With the arrival of the new man, Min Seong, “His Man’s House” is thrown into chaos. From choosing roommates to picking dates, the men find themselves caught in an intense tug-of-war of stolen chances and shifting feelings. As the situation grows more unpredictable, what fate awaits their hearts?

videos.title: The Direction of the Heart
videos.overview: A text message arrives for the men who need reassurance about each other’s feelings. “Please place a gift filled with your feelings into the mailbox of the person you’re drawn to.” And then, sooner than ever, comes the time for “anonymous chat.” Whom are their hearts heading toward? Are those feelings directed at each other?

videos.title: One-on-One Date
videos.overview: The long-awaited day of the one-on-one date arrives. But not everyone is given the chance!? Only men whose feelings align are granted this fated one-on-one date. Will this date turn out to be poison… or the beginning of love?

videos.title: Tell Me Honestly
videos.overview: Eleven men gather in one place. Through a game of Jenga, they share honest thoughts and take time to get to know each other a little better. But in the process, subtle feelings of jealousy and rivalry begin to surface… On what seems like a calm night, an elimination vote is waiting for the men...

videos.title: An Inevitable Choice
videos.overview: The moment everyone hoped would never come finally arrives at His Man’s House. The men are asked to rank their feelings from first to tenth place, and the results lead to a separation no one saw coming, leaving them shaken and unable to believe what’s happening.

videos.title: Love Is All about Timing
videos.overview: The men begin to step closer, to question more, and to express hearts that burn hot one moment and turn cold the next. As each of them discovers a different direction of love, they write separate love stories within the same moment in time. For the men, is the timing of love bringing happiness… or sorrow?

videos.title: Your Voice
videos.overview:
For the men who need certainty, the time for another call arrives. No one can afford to let their guard down even for a second. Will they finally hear the voice they’ve been waiting for on the other end of the line?

(Source: Korean = Wavve || Translation = MyDramaList)

videos.title: Day & Night Dates
videos.overview: With time running out, the men grow more anxious as they’re given two separate dating chances in a single day, one in the daytime and one at night. What everyone expected to be sweet and romantic turns into disappointment and missed connections for some. As true feelings finally come into focus, can the men make it through this confusing phase?  (Source: Korean = Wavve || Translation = MyDramaList)

videos.title: Late Regret
videos.overview: The feelings they have for each other grow clearer than ever. Lingering attachment that refuses to fade as easily as hoped clashes with the guilt of being unable to accept someone else’s heart. A regret that has come too late… is it already too late to turn someone’s heart back?  (Source: Korean = Wavve || Translation = MyDramaList)

videos.title: The Final Date
videos.overview: Another voting text message throws the men’s morning into chaos. With the final choice approaching, the men begin their last dates. More honest and bolder than ever before, how will their final dates unfold…?  (Source: Korean = Wavve || Translation = MyDramaList)

videos.title: Goodbye, Goodbye
videos.overview: The final moment has arrived for the men who bid farewell with such anticipation. What did those seven short yet intense days mean to each of them…? Having passed through a tunnel of countless emotions, will they all be able to say goodbye with a smile at this final moment of choice…?
